definition-changed.flag: class | of a data item; index
definition-changed.answer: 'index' §2002:4 (4.102 'A storage area or a register, the content of which refers to a particular element in a table') vs 2023 3.102 'conceptual data item' is wording only; 'a data item of class index' is category index (§2002:8.5.2.6 'An elementary data item explicitly or implicitly described as usage index', or an index function), the same Table 3 row as 2023. The open 2002 usage-national reading (PB5625) cannot make an item class index. Scope unchanged.
